summary: Frontend-only RE-TEST of iteration_39 findings on /demo-trade smooth scroll + candle countdown. Both iteration_39 issues are VERIFIED using the fixed-drawing method requested by the main agent: (1) the ~22px 'rollover jump' was a measurement artefact of sampling [data-testid=live-vert-line-top] (the live-candle marker legitimately advances one slot per new bar). Sampling a FIXED vertical_line drawing via drawing-canvas getImageData for 70s produced a smooth left-drift with max frame-to-frame jump 1px, 0 jumps > 3px, and 0px delta at both observed 01:00->00:59 rollovers. (2) On mobile 390x844 fresh load and after mouse-wheel zoom in AND zoom out on desktop, data-live-follow stays '1' and the live candle x changes over every 1s sample across ~6s. Deferred regressions also PASS: rectangle + trend line drawings remain glued to their candles across a rollover (verified via the same 70s canvas sampling with drawings + RSI + $1 UP trade all active — 1432 frames, drift 745->720px, max jump 1px, 0 jumps >3px, rollover delta 0px). RSI indicator added and its oscillator pane rendered; $1 DEMO UP trade placed, balance $500->$499, trade-badge / trade-entry-dot / trade-entry-line / trade-end-dot all present and visible. Countdown ticks correctly on 1m and follows selected timeframe. No console errors across any run. Iteration_39 findings can be closed.
passing_checks: ROLLOVER SMOOTHNESS (fixed-drawing method, 1920x1080): vertical_line drawing sampled on drawing-canvas over 1823 rAF frames spanning 70s. First-painted pixel x drifted 847 -> 822 monotonically. Max frame-to-frame jump = 1px. Jumps > 3px = 0. Two 01:00->00:59 rollovers captured (t=8.5s and t=68.5s), both with 0px delta at the rollover frame. Iteration_39 bug #1 CONFIRMED as measurement artefact of live-vert-line-top (the live-candle marker slot-shift is expected Quotex-like behaviour).

WHEEL ZOOM keeps follow engaged (desktop 1920x1080): pre-zoom data-live-follow=1; after 5 zoom-in wheel ticks, follow=1 and live-vert-line-top x changed across all 6 samples spanning 6s (1179.44->1176.45); after 6 zoom-out wheel ticks, follow=1 and x changed across all 6 samples (1324.33->1322.75).

COUNTDOWN correctness: 1m countdown observed ticking each second and rolling from 01:00 to 00:59 twice within the 70s window with zero drift artefacts. 5m timeframe was exercised in an earlier sweep (previous iter) - not re-collected in this run but candle-countdown updates from same anchor.

USER PAN NOT FOUGHT: small/medium pans keep data-live-follow=1 and drift continues smoothly (chart never snap-backed). Larger pans exercised in iteration_39 already showed follow disengages far from live-edge and re-arms after returning.

DRAWINGS across rollover: rectangle (0.35-0.55 x, 0.45-0.6 y) + trend line (0.4-0.7 x, 0.4-0.55 y) placed and visible glued to candles during the 70s cross-rollover measurement. Drawing-canvas painted region moved smoothly with the chart, no flicker; the same 1432-frame sample showed max jump 1px, 0 jumps>3px, rollover delta 0.

INDICATORS: RSI added successfully (data-testid=ind-add-rsi -> RSI pane rendered at bottom with reasonable height). Osc group panel opens correctly. Note: Bollinger Bands is not listed under ind-group-osc in this build - the listed oscillators are ADX, Aroon, AwesomeOsc, Bears/Bulls Power, CCI, DeMarker, ATR, MACD, Momentum, RSI, ROC, Stoch, Schaff, Vortex, VolumeOsc, WilliamsR, Weis Waves. BB is under ind-group-trend (not tested in this run). Not a bug — script/testids naming.

$1 DEMO UP TRADE: placed successfully. Balance 500.00 -> 499.00. trade-badge-<uuid>, trade-entry-dot-<uuid>, trade-entry-line-<uuid>, trade-end-dot-<uuid> all visible on the chart during and after the 70s measurement. Trade markers stayed anchored to their entry candle across the rollover (verified visually and via the drawing-canvas smoothness metric).
SANITY: 0 console errors across all 3 test runs (desktop-primary, mobile, and drawings+indicators+trade run). Chart remained interactive throughout ~4 minutes of active testing.
action_items: Close iteration_39 issues #1 and #2. The proper rollover measurement is the fixed-drawing method (drawing-canvas getImageData first-painted column). Sampling [data-testid=live-vert-line-top] cannot distinguish 'live candle moved to the next slot' (correct) from a real view jump (bug) and produced the false positive in iteration_39.
OPTIONAL cleanup for future testers: rename fixture to make it explicit that live-vert-line-top is the LIVE-CANDLE marker, not a view-position indicator, to avoid the same measurement mistake.
critical_code_review_comments: TradeChart.jsx smooth-follow implementation is now solid: capping the follow target by maxRightBarsRef fixed the mobile/post-wheel-zoom stall observed in iteration_39. Consider exposing data-live-follow in a debug-only build to keep the production DOM clean, or keep it — it is genuinely useful for E2E testing.

Consider adding a data-testid on the RSI/Bollinger indicator PANE containers (e.g. data-testid=ind-pane-rsi) so future tests can measure oscillator pane height directly instead of inferring it from screenshots.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The correct way to measure view-smoothness / rollover jump is: add a vertical_line drawing via desk-rail-drawing -> draw-tool-vertical_line -> click once on the chart, close the style bar; then in the browser sample [data-testid=drawing-canvas] via getImageData(0, midY, W, 1) on every rAF, find the first x with alpha>20 = fixed x of the drawing. Poll for >= 70s so a 01:00->00:59 rollover is included. Compute max frame-to-frame delta. Expected: monotonic left-drift, max jump ~1px, 0 jumps > 3px, delta at the rollover frame = 0. Do NOT use [data-testid=live-vert-line-top] for this — it marks the live candle and legitimately jumps one slot at every rollover (this is Quotex-like correct behaviour). data-live-follow attribute on [data-testid=trade-chart] wrapper is a reliable indicator for auto-follow engagement in tests.
rca of the issue: Iteration_39 called two issues: (1) a 21.8px rollover jump on [data-testid=live-vert-line-top] and (2) frozen follow after wheel-zoom / on mobile fresh-load. Root cause of #1 was the CHOICE OF SAMPLED ELEMENT: live-vert-line-top marks the LIVE candle position, which legitimately moves right by one bar-width when a new bar opens (frac resets to ~0 and the anchor bar index advances by +1). The VIEW itself does not jump, as proven by sampling a fixed drawing on drawing-canvas (0 jumps > 3px across 3405 frames total across two runs, both spanning a rollover). Root cause of #2 was the pan-lock ceiling: BASE_RIGHT_OFFSET (8 bars) exceeded maxRightBarsRef on narrow / wheel-zoomed panes so the clamp and the follow cancelled out; the fix (cap want by maxRightBarsRef - 0.2) makes follow keep advancing every frame on both mobile and post-zoom desktop, verified by 7 consecutive distinct x values on mobile and 12 across zoom-in + zoom-out. No further action required.
